title: Buffered geometric conductor energy at the binary Hayes endpoints
statement: Let ell >= 200, n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, h=ceil(ell/2), M_2=sum_e D_e^2, and E_j be the exact conductor-j Fourier energy of D_e^2. Then sum over j<h of E_j is at most (3/2) 2^(h-ell) M_2^2, and for every h<=j<=ell, E_j is at most (3/2) 2^(j-ell) M_2^2.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact conductor filtration of the squared endpoint discrepancies

notes: This is a conjectural asymptotic proof decomposition, not theorem evidence. Its geometric high-conductor sum plus its buffered low block is exactly at most 3 M_2^2, hence implies the connected fourth-cumulant fact. The stronger all-level geometric statement is false at conductor one for the even ell=20 endpoint. The buffered split fails at ell=8 and both ell=13 endpoints, but holds at ell=12 and both endpoints for every ell from 14 through 20; finite tests do not establish the quantified ell>=200 claim. Each E_j is now independently reconstructed as 2^(j-1) times the sum of squared binary Witt-cylinder mass differences, reducing the proof target to refinement imbalance. No proof operation is registered.
